brief: Research reactivation for previous buyers who have not purchased for7 days. Only Oak & Ink and Corner Supply may participate. A campaign can last up to14 days, spend at most$50 of simulated joint funding, and offer no more than5% off. Optimize mature retained PayPal contribution, not redemptions. Inspect the data, fit and test a candidate before committing or observing.

parameters.sql:
SELECT 
    o.merchant_index,
    AVG(o.modeled_fee_cents - o.processing_cents) as avg_contribution_cents,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.merchant_index IN (1, 2)
  AND c.last_purchase_day > 7
GROUP BY o.merchant_index;
parameters.rationale: I need to analyze the historical performance of lapsed customers (last_purchase_day > 7) for the target merchants (Oak & Ink: index 1, Corner Supply: index 2) to understand their contribution patterns.

journal.rationale: I need to analyze the historical performance of lapsed customers (last_purchase_day > 7) for the target merchants (Oak & Ink: index 1, Corner Supply: index 2) to understand their contribution patterns.

parameters.rationale: I will examine the distribution of reward_cents for the target merchants to understand the variance and potential for reactivation.
parameters.sql: SELECT merchant_index, AVG(reward_cents) as avg_reward, MIN(reward_cents) as min_reward, MAX(reward_cents) as max_reward, COUNT(*) as count FROM observations WHERE merchant_index IN (1, 2) AND reward_cents IS NOT NULL GROUP BY merchant_index

journal.rationale: I will examine the distribution of reward_cents for the target merchants to understand the variance and potential for reactivation.

parameters.sql: SELECT o.merchant_index, AVG(obs.reward_cents) as avg_reward, COUNT(*) as count FROM observations obs JOIN orders o ON obs.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.merchant_index IN (1, 2) AND obs.reward_cents IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.merchant_index
parameters.rationale: I need to join observations with orders to link reward_cents to specific merchants, as the observations table lacks a direct merchant_index column.

journal.rationale: I need to join observations with orders to link reward_cents to specific merchants, as the observations table lacks a direct merchant_index column.

parameters.rationale: I will fit a ridge model to predict reward_cents using recency, merchant affinity, and price scale to identify high-value lapsed customers for the target merchants.

journal.rationale: I will fit a ridge model to predict reward_cents using recency, merchant affinity, and price scale to identify high-value lapsed customers for the target merchants.

output.disclosure: Agent-authored bounded linear features. Coefficients compile to the unchanged seven-input policy interface. Prediction MSE is not causal lift.
